create_feature_refactor_specializations.purpose: Clean change-type specialization catalog with PTB-aligned documentation, update planning, unit-test planning and local resource reuse.
create_feature_refactor_specializations.point_of_truth: Create Prompt tab entry inserted by Add selected entry; Build.complete, Start-tab target match, selected scope and mapping provide write authority.

specializations.label: Software Documentation
specializations.description: Feature-only documentation/update plan, optionally aligned to one PTB/WELMEC schema profile.

specializations.label: Unit Test Plan
specializations.description: Project-native unit test plan or small test patch from existing framework evidence.

specializations.label: Resource Reuse Feature
specializations.description: Develop a feature by reusing local utilities, docs, fixtures, components or schema resources.

specializations.label: Context Discovery
specializations.description: Evidence-ranked feature proposal from project context.

specializations.label: Autonomous Feature Slice
specializations.description: One bounded feature patch selected from context evidence and validation feasibility.

specializations.label: Behavior-Preserving Refactor
specializations.description: Internal restructuring only, no behavior/docs/fix work.

specializations.label: Resource Reuse Refactor
specializations.description: Replace duplication/parallel code with local resources while preserving behavior.

specializations.label: Testability Refactor
specializations.description: Introduce small seams/extractions that make unit tests possible without behavior change.

specializations.label: Last-Git-Commit Feature
specializations.description: Read-only last commit reference injected into Prompt Builder, USER_PROMPT and manifests when selected or enabled.

specializations.label: System Plan Expansion
specializations.description: Adds more plan-first feature/refactor slice types and larger system planning entries.

specializations.label: Last-Git-Commit Hardening
specializations.description: Behavior-preserving hardening of scan cache, error handling and manifest alignment for the Git reference.

specializations.label: Slice Catalog Consolidation
specializations.description: Keeps built-in plans, chain boilerplates, specializations and target modules aligned without duplicate pseudo-plans.

specializations.label: Prompt Pipeline Boundary Hardening
specializations.description: Keeps Prompt Builder, USER_PROMPT, export hooks and command manifest boundaries consistent without changing behavior.

scale_values.label: Begrenzte change
scale_values.rule: Scope is determined by evidence and validation, not by catalog multiplication.

resolution_order: resolve PTB/test/reuse schema only when selected
select LAST-GIT-COMMIT plan before prompt compile
run Patch-tab read-only Git scan once per selection signature
embed Reference D only when selected plan or checkbox enables it
write TASKS.TXT sidecar when Prompt Builder left input is present
non_goals: No unit-test framework installation without evidence.
No PTB/WELMEC compliance or certification claim.
create_feature_refactor_specializations.autonomous_feature_rule: Autonomous entries must rank candidates from observed context and select at most one low-risk, validation-ready feature slice.
create_feature_refactor_specializations.documentation_rule: Software documentation is feature-only and chooses exactly one PTB/WELMEC schema profile when PTB alignment is requested.
create_feature_refactor_specializations.resource_reuse_rule: Feature and refactor plans inspect selected scope/import graph/project tree/dependency layer before creating parallel resources.

last_git_commit_reference_rule.output: Reference D in Prompt Builder, USER_PROMPT and manifests when enabled/selected

prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.tasks_txt: TASKS.TXT is an automatic Prompt Builder sidecar hook, not a Create Feature/Refactor specialization.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.shortcut_commands: USER_PROMPT shortcut commands are an export hook mirrored into CMD.json; they are not selectable catalog specializations.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.last_git_commit: Last-Git-Commit remains a selectable Feature/Refactor plan because selecting that plan triggers a read-only Git scan before Prompt Builder compilation.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.tasks_sidecar: TASKS.TXT remains a Prompt Builder sidecar and never becomes a Create catalog specialization.

feature_refactor_mode_boundary_rule.summary: Feature and Refactor specializations must not model create_new_abstraction itself. New project abstractions live in create_new_abstraction schemas; Feature/Refactor work starts from verified existing-project evidence.

reference_domains.label: Clean Feature/Refactor Catalog Reference
rules: classify feature, fix, docs and refactor as separate change types
do not multiply plans by artificial scale

operation_roles.label: Clean Feature/Refactor Catalog Operator
rules: select exactly one catalog entry per requested change type
